ringBefore.line: ✨ CAPSTONE: Seed Vault. Every seed you have ever pocketed, kept dry and dreaming. It weighs almost nothing. Almost. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
Everything stops. Not all at once — conversations trail off, a dropped spoon rings too loud. Every face turns toward Omar.

Olivia: "I saw it happen. I was THERE."
Rosa: "We all felt it. Like the air changed its mind."
Catalina: "I have no words. I am making do with these."

The soil near you is warm. Things are growing that you didn't plant. Look at Omar. Look at what the light does around them now. Omar is The Living Garden — Blooming, Grown-Over. A figure half-lost in vines and blossoms — green-gold, flowers opening along the shoulders, roots at the feet. The garden, walking.

Godhood demands its price, and the price is not hidden: Once per day. It costs you 200 kcal of your own — the garden gives, but through you. You're not a fighter. Your garden needs guards, and everyone knows it.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Your pack is full — water is heavy (1L = 1kg). Drink some or drop weight before filling.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
That goes on your melee, not your ranged.
"REPEATED BEHAVIOR DETECTED." The hammer comes up. The circle on the ground brightens — purple, the color of a bruise.
Amina left 1 branch by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.

refusalLines.line: The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A hovering shape with a hammer, drawing a circle on the ground around itself. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE MODERATOR! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
Sergio doesn't look away. "About time someone fought back."
It comes apart — no one in reach, no one chasing. The fight ends; they melt back into the wilds.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
🐗 This one came with the raid on Haven — it was with the teeth at the door, not a lone wanderer.
